detail.longDescription: I want to start a blog primarily as a writing exercise and habit. I do not want to (as is my habit:) get derailed and make it a massive infrastructure optimization project :O I do own my own domain and have hosting available via ionos. I'm OK paying a small monthly fee for easy onboarding and responsive layout. Key criteria is: lowest possible friction to start writing, some small theme/layout/feel personalization, and ability to export once I do eventually make an extensive infra/self-hosted project out of it :-D
